irq_assertion_deassertion.normalization: Raw NBA registered DMA-activation/IRQ-line callbacks and Java enabled IF/readiness. Current-deadline events run before CPU start; peripheral propagation latency is excluded.

independent_comparison.scope: Selected readiness-normalized fetch/retirement/accepted-IRQ observations; not full pipeline, propagation/activation or physical hardware qualification

regressions.before_bridge: Constant-false public Cpu.fetchInFlight() query added only to isolated old classes to load new tests; no emulation changes
coverage: 60 IRQ assertion/deassertion cases with two retirement states each
Four 65536-word EWRAM-to-EWRAM transfers keep fetch/IRQ decisions across frame/audio budgets without overwriting code
HALT starts no fetch before wakeup
Deferred fetch fault clears pending state and CPU access context
IRQ banks status/link after the discarded fetch finishes

fixture_updates.reason: DMA-only repeated-transfer fixtures used Cpu.step as a controller operation. A waiting CPU now correctly receives one access between ownership intervals; these fixtures call runPending directly.
